empty: Design a spacecraft before starting a simulation.
eventHelp: Mission clock paused. Every response changes the outcome. Choose a response to continue.
logEmpty: Mission control is tracking your flight. Events will appear here as they happen.
notOperating: Spacecraft is in safe mode or not collecting science.
trajectory: Illustrative mission trajectory. The spacecraft position follows playback, not orbital physics.
flightSummary: This is a compressed educational mission, with a reproducible seed and simplified physics.
noFailures: No limiting factors detected for this run.
noStrengths: Start with the suggested changes, then fly the same seed to compare.
telemetryHelp: Each line uses a percentage so different resources can be compared. Budget over 100% means overspending.
sameSeed: Both missions used the same seed: a fair comparison of design decisions.
differentSeed: These missions use different seeds; events may explain part of the difference.
exportError: The image could not be exported. You can still save the report as PDF.
printHint: The print dialog lets you choose “Save as PDF”.
simulationDisclaimer: Educational model. Values and flight dynamics are simplified; this is not an engineering design tool.
noReport: Complete a mission to open the report.
